injection_details.method: Remote PE injection / manual PE mapping: OpenProcess(0x43A) -> VirtualAllocEx(NULL, SizeOfImage, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) -> NtWriteVirtualMemory of PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) and of each section (raw->virtual) -> manual base-relocation processing (IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64: ReadProcessMemory 8 bytes, add (remoteBase - OptionalHeader.ImageBase) delta, NtWriteVirtualMemory back) -> CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0, remoteBase+AddressOfEntryPoint, lpParameter=remoteBase, 0, NULL) -> WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 10000) -> CloseHandle/NtClose. On failure: VirtualFreeEx(MEM_RELEASE=0x8000) + NtClose
injection_details.target_process: explorer.exe (fallback: own process via GetCurrentProcessId if explorer.exe is not found)
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=2) + Process32First/Process32Next, PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile compared with strcmp against "explorer.exe" (routine at 0x14000176c)
injection_details.payload_write_primitive: ntdll!NtWriteVirtualMemory, resolved at runtime with GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress (helper at 0x1400016a9); WriteProcessMemory is deliberately NOT imported (only ReadProcessMemory is, used for relocation read-back)
injection_details.payload_source: 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob embedded at .data 0x140004000 (file offset 0x2800), decrypted on the stack before injection; header parsing helpers: SizeOfImage at 0x140001891 (NT hdr+0x50), AddressOfEntryPoint at 0x140001831 (NT hdr+0x28)
injection_details.cleanup: VirtualFreeEx(MEM_RELEASE) and NtClose on every error path; NtClose on process handle at the end

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (textbook implementation: 256-byte KSA at 0x140001480 with S[i]=i and j=(j+S[i]+key[i%keylen]); PRGA/XOR stream at 0x140001573, i/j persisted at state+0x100/+0x104)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded plaintext byte array in .rdata at VA 0x140005000 (file offset 0x2A00), not NUL-terminated; length 0x10 passed explicitly to the key-schedule call

decoded_strings.note: The 64-byte .data blob is RC4-decrypted at runtime into a stack buffer and then treated as a PE image to be mapped into explorer.exe; plaintext not recovered statically (would require RC4 emulation). All other strings (ntdll.dll, sbiedll.dll, dbghelp.dll, SymSetOptions, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtClose, explorer.exe) are stored in cleartext in .rdata.

anti_analysis: Sandboxie detection: GetModuleHandleA("sbiedll.dll") - if loaded, abort

API-hook / EDR evasion: injection writes use dynamically resolved ntdll native APIs (NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtClose) instead of the higher-level Win32 WriteProcessMemory/CloseHandle (WriteProcessMemory is not in the import table)
Sensitive payload kept RC4-encrypted in .data so no PE/MZ signature or strings are visible statically
Binary is stripped (no symbols, external PDB reference removed)
